issues.problem: "तुम्हारे लिए ... के लिए" double dative; and तेज is used for tejas in unit 3, so varcas needs a different word.
yad ... tad hiraṇyam: yat can be the relative "which" agreeing with hiraṇyam ("the gold that the Dākṣāyaṇas bound on ... that I bind on you"); "when" is possible but weaker.
issues.fix: Add note: yat may be the relative "which".

patch.text: yat may be the relative 'which' (agreeing with hiraṇyam): 'the gold that the Dākṣāyaṇas bound on for Śatānīka, that I bind on you'.

issues.problem: Per layer notes an epithet stays an epithet unless the line makes the name certain; keep the name reading but say it is a reading.
issues.fix: Add to notes: Śatānīka read as a name; could be an epithet "hundred-hosted".

issues.problem: dakṣamāṇaḥ is intransitive ("growing strong"); "बल बढ़ाता" makes it transitive.
"impv./inj." is a guess; bibharat is not the usual 3 sg. impv. (bibhartu).
issues.fix: Say "3 sg. (injunctive or subjunctive?), uncertain" and keep confidence medium.

issues.problem: te is the enclitic dative/genitive, not accusative (tvā is the accusative).

issues.where: With the years, the months and the seasons
issues.problem: samānām māsām are genitives plural, only ṛtubhiḥ is instrumental; the draft makes all three instrumental. Also vayam ("we") is dropped from the English/Hindi although the note says both are kept.
issues.fix: With the seasons of the years and months, and with the milk of the year, we (I) fill you; may Indra and Agni and all the gods, not being angry, give their assent to you.

patch.value: With the seasons of the years and months, and with the milk of the year, we (I) fill you; may Indra and Agni and all the gods, not being angry, give their assent to you.
